proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B C D hA hB hC hD hAC hs
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hmA := left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C
  have hmC := right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C
  have hBA : B ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hBC : B ≠ C := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ hmC)
  have hDA : D ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmA)
  have hDC : D ≠ C := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ hmC)
  have hn1 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
    hs.2.1 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAC)
  have hn2 : ¬Collinear ℝ ({C, D, A} : Set P) := fun hcol =>
    hs.2.2 (hcol.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) hAC)
  have h2 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.two_zsmul_oangle_eq hA hB hD hC hBA hBC hDA hDC
  have hsign := hs.oangle_sign_eq_neg hmA hmC
  have hsign' : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle C D A).sign = (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A B C).sign := by
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev, Real.Angle.sign_neg, hsign, neg_neg]
  have hsum : (2 : ℤ) • (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A B C + EuclideanGeometry.oangle C D A) = 0 := by
    rw [smul_add, h2, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev A D C, smul_neg]; simp
  have hx0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn1
  have hx1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn1
  have hy0 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hn2
  have hy1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear hn2
  set x := EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C with hx
  set y := EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A with hy
  have key : (2 : ℤ) • (((x + y : ℝ)) : Real.Angle) = 0 → x + y = Real.pi := by
    intro h
    rw [Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_zero_iff] at h
    have hθ : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle).toReal = x + y - Real.pi :=
      Real.Angle.toReal_coe_eq_self_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rcases h with h | h
    · exfalso
      have : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle) = (Real.pi : Real.Angle) := by
        rw [Real.Angle.coe_sub, h]; simp
      rw [this, Real.Angle.toReal_pi] at hθ
      linarith
    · have : ((x + y - Real.pi : ℝ) : Real.Angle) = 0 := by
        rw [Real.Angle.coe_sub, h]; simp
      rw [this, Real.Angle.toReal_zero] at hθ
      linarith
  apply key
  rcases hc : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A B C).sign with _ | _ | _
  · exfalso
    exact hn1 (EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear.mp hc)
  · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one hc
    have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_neg_angle_of_sign_eq_neg_one (hsign'.trans hc)
    rw [ea, eb] at hsum
    rw [Real.Angle.coe_add]
    rw [← neg_add, smul_neg, neg_eq_zero] at hsum
    exact hsum
  · have ea := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one hc
    have eb := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one (hsign'.trans hc)
    rw [ea, eb] at hsum
    rw [Real.Angle.coe_add]
    exact hsum
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → D ∈ s → A ≠ C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SOppSide B D → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C + EuclideanGeometry.angle C D A = Real.pi
